period.text: Your uterus is doing its monthly renovation. Excuse the noise.
Day {cycleDay}. Heating pad: on. Expectations: gently lowered.
Cramps are temporary. Your excellent taste in snacks is forever.
Permission granted to cancel plans and call it self-care.
Hydrate, rest, repeat. You're doing great.
Your body is working hard today. Be as kind to it as you'd be to a friend.
Chocolate counts as a food group this week. We checked. (We didn't.)
Soft clothes, warm drinks, low effort. That's the whole plan.
Reminder: you can do hard things and also take a nap.
Be gentle with yourself today. Extra blanket recommended.

follicular.text: Energy's back. Main character arc unlocked.
Your energy is on the way up. Maybe start that thing you've been putting off?
Fresh cycle, fresh start. What's on the list this week?
Good day for a long walk, a new playlist, or both.
Feeling more social? Text the group chat back. They miss you.
Brain feeling sharp? Great time to tackle something tricky.
Welcome to your 'say yes to plans' era.
Day {cycleDay}: a solid day to try something new.

ovulation.text: Hormones are peaking. You may feel unreasonably confident today. Use it wisely.
Peak energy week. Ask for the thing. Send the email.
You might feel extra chatty today. The group chat has been warned.
Confidence: high. Patience for nonsense: surprisingly also high.
Great day for a workout, a big task, or a dramatic hair decision. Maybe not the last one.
Your mood may be on an upswing. Enjoy the good vibes.
Feeling bold? Good day to speak up in that meeting.
Energy's at its peak. Go outside and touch some grass.
If you feel like you could take on the world today, you're probably right.
Today's forecast: sunny, with a high chance of getting things done.

luteal.text: Slowing down a little is allowed.
Energy dipping a bit? Totally normal. Pace yourself.
Cozy season has begun. Blanket fort optional but encouraged.
Craving carbs? That's just your body being honest.
Good week for finishing things rather than starting them.
A quiet evening in sounds about right.
Feeling more inward? Read, journal, recharge.
Extra sleep is a valid productivity strategy.
Be patient with yourself. Your hormones are doing a lot right now.
Snacks within arm's reach at all times. Just a suggestion.

pms.text: You're not being dramatic. It's progesterone.
If everything feels a little extra right now, there's a reason. It'll pass.
Period in about {daysUntilNext} days. Stock up on snacks and patience.
Your future self says: pack the essentials in your bag now.
Feeling short-tempered? Not your fault. Take a breather.
Cravings are real. Snacks are allowed. No notes.
Low-key day recommended. Comfy clothes, easy plans.
Teared up at an advert? Completely normal this week.
Be extra kind to yourself, and maybe give the people around you a heads-up.
Almost there. Hot water bottle on standby.

late.text: Your period is a little later than predicted. Cycles shift with stress, travel and sleep.
Your period hasn't arrived yet. Log it when it does and predictions will update.

possibly_skipped.text: Looks like this cycle may have been skipped. Predictions have moved to your next likely period.
No period logged this cycle. Predictions will update as soon as you log one.

paused.text: Predictions are paused. You can still log anything you like.

no_data.text: Log your period to get started.

neutral.text: Logging regularly helps predictions get more accurate.
